description: STM32G431xB: Arm Cortex-M4 32-bit MCU+FPU, 170MHz/213DMIPS, up to 128KB Flash, 32KB SRAM, rich analog (2x ADC, 4x DAC, 4x rail-to-rail comparators, 3x op-amps, CORDIC/FMAC math accelerators), 14 timers incl. 2x 16-bit advanced motor control timers (TIM1/TIM8) with dead-time generation and emergency stop, for FOC/BLDC motor control. LQFP48 package.

pinout.name: VBAT
pinout.notes: Backup battery supply for RTC, LSE and backup registers, 1.55-3.6V. Powered from VDD via power switch when VDD present. Not decoupled per datasheet Figure 16 power supply scheme (only VDD, VDDA, VREF+ shown decoupled).

pinout.name: PC13
pinout.notes: 5V-tolerant I/O (FT). Alt func: TIM1_BKIN, TIM1_CH1N, TIM8_CH4N, EVENTOUT. Additional func: WKUP2, RTC_TAMP1, RTC_TS, RTC_OUT1. Supplied through internal power switch (limited to 3mA sink); in output mode speed must not exceed 2MHz/30pF load and must not be used as a current source (note 2). After backup domain power-up behaves as GPIO until RTC registers configure it (note 3).

pinout.name: PC14-OSC32_IN
pinout.notes: 5V-tolerant I/O (FT). Alt func: EVENTOUT. Additional func: OSC32_IN (32.768kHz crystal input). Same power-switch current limit as PC13 (notes 2,3).

pinout.name: PC15-OSC32_OUT
pinout.notes: 5V-tolerant I/O (FT). Alt func: EVENTOUT. Additional func: OSC32_OUT (32.768kHz crystal output). Same power-switch current limit as PC13 (notes 2,3).

pinout.name: PF0-OSC_IN
pinout.notes: Input-only pin, FT_fa (5V tolerant, analog switch via VDDA). Alt func: I2C2_SDA, SPI2_NSS/I2S2_WS, TIM1_CH3N, EVENTOUT. Additional func: ADC1_IN10, OSC_IN (4-48MHz crystal input).

pinout.name: PF1-OSC_OUT
pinout.notes: Output-only pin, FT_a. Alt func: SPI2_SCK/I2S2_CK, EVENTOUT. Additional func: ADC2_IN10, COMP3_INM, OSC_OUT (crystal output).

pinout.name: PG10-NRST

decoupling.value: 100nF ceramic per VDD/VSS pin pair + 1x 4.7uF bulk
decoupling.placement: as close as possible to, or below, the VDD/VSS pins on the underside of the PCB
decoupling.notes: Datasheet Figure 16 'Power supply scheme': 'n x 100 nF + 1 x 4.7 uF' across the n VDD/VSS pin pairs (3 pairs on LQFP48: VDD/VSS at pins 24/23, 36/35, 48/47). Caution note: each power supply pair (VDD/VSS, VDDA/VSSA etc.) must be decoupled with filtering ceramic capacitors as shown, placed as close as possible to, or below, the appropriate pins.

decoupling.placement: as close as possible to, or below, the VDDA/VSSA pins
decoupling.notes: Datasheet Figure 16 power supply scheme, VDDA/VSSA branch.

decoupling.placement: as close as possible to, or below, the VREF+ pin, referenced to VSSA (this package ties VREF- internally, no separate VREF- pin on LQFP48)
decoupling.notes: Datasheet Figure 16 power supply scheme, VREF+ branch.

land_pattern.package: LQFP48, 7x7mm body (D1=E1=7.0mm typ, overall D=E=9.0mm typ with leads), 0.5mm pitch
land_pattern.notes: From datasheet Table 94 (LQFP48 mechanical data) and Figure 50 (LQFP48 recommended footprint): 48 perimeter gull-wing leads, lead width b=0.22mm typ (0.17-0.27mm range), recommended land pad 0.30mm x 1.20mm at 0.50mm pitch. Footprint span (pad outer edge to pad outer edge) 9.70mm x 9.70mm, inner span 7.30mm x 7.30mm between pad inner edges, 5.80mm between pad centers on opposite sides (per Figure 50 dimensions 9.70/7.30/5.80/1.20/0.30/0.50). No exposed pad on this package; pad_count=48 covers only the 48 perimeter leads.

layout_notes: Decoupling: 100nF ceramic on each of the three VDD/VSS pin pairs (24/23, 36/35, 48/47) plus one shared 4.7uF bulk capacitor on VDD, placed as close as possible to (or below, on the underside of the PCB) the supply pins (Figure 16, caution note).
VDDA/VSSA (pins 21/19): decouple with 10nF + 1uF close to the pins (Figure 16).
VREF+ (pin 20): decouple with 100nF + 1uF close to the pin; this package has no separate VREF- pin (tied internally), so the reference return is VSSA.

BOOT0 is multiplexed on PB8 (pin 45, PB8-BOOT0). Datasheet note (5): set PB8 to a mode other than analog after startup to limit consumption if the pin is left unconnected. Boot mode selection (BOOT0 sampled at reset) requires an external pull to define a known level at reset per the reference manual; the datasheet text extracted here does not state a specific pull value, so external pull sizing is not grounded from this document.
NRST is on PG10-NRST (pin 7), a bidirectional reset pin with an embedded weak pull-up resistor (Table 11 legend); no external decoupling/pull value stated in the extracted datasheet text.

PC13, PC14-OSC32_IN and PC15-OSC32_OUT (pins 2-4) are supplied through an internal power switch that sinks a limited 3mA: in output mode their speed must not exceed 2MHz into a 30pF load and they must not be used as current sources (e.g. driving an LED) (notes 2,3).

Debug pins PA13/PA14/PA15/PB3/PB4 (SWDIO/SWCLK/JTDI/JTDO/JTRST, pins 37,38,39,40,41) come out of reset configured as JTAG/SW debug alternate functions with internal pull-up (PA13,PA15,PB3,PB4) or pull-down (PA14) active (note 4).

ADC inputs that are also comparator non-inverting (COMPx_INP) inputs, relevant for current-sense/overcurrent routing: PA0 (pin8, ADC12_IN1 + COMP3_INP), PA1 (pin9, ADC12_IN2 + COMP1_INP), PA7 (pin15, ADC2_IN4 + COMP2_INP), PB0 (pin16, ADC1_IN15 + COMP4_INP), PB1 (pin17, ADC1_IN12 + COMP1_INP).
